grade: Crianças pequenas (4 anos a 5 anos e 11 meses)
subject: O eu, o outro e o nós
description_pt: Demonstrar empatia pelos outros, percebendo que as pessoas têm diferentes sentimentos, necessidades e maneiras de pensar e agir.

components.description_pt: Reconhecer que outros podem ter sentimentos diferentes dos próprios
components.description_en: Recognize that others may have feelings different from one's own
components.cc_component_description: Respond thoughtfully to perspectives that differ from one's own during discussion

components.description_pt: Identificar as diferentes necessidades e modos de pensar das pessoas ao redor
components.description_en: Identify the different needs and ways of thinking of people around them
components.cc_component_description: Identify changes in the thinking of others based on new information or feedback

components.description_pt: Demonstrar respostas empáticas diante de outros em situações sociais
components.description_en: Demonstrate empathetic responses toward others in social situations

cc_matches.description: Respond thoughtfully to diverse perspectives, summarize points of agreement and disagreement, and, when warranted, qualify or justify their own views and understanding and make new connections in light of the evidence and reasoning presented.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán interpretar argumentos para...
* decidir lo que se puede hacer con y sin ayuda
* evaluar la credibilidad y relevancia de la información
* distinguir las opiniones y las razones de otros
* formar sus propias opiniones a través de razonamiento
* responder a la retroalimentación
* identificar cambios en el pensamiento de otros
